abstract_research_topics.justification: Shared decision-making is primarily theoretical and deals with abstract frameworks for making decisions collaboratively.
This is a theoretical domain addressing the challenge of making decisions based on multiple criteria, often requiring abstract modeling.
Decision theory is a theoretical framework that involves abstract models for understanding and rationalizing decision-making processes.
This deals with abstract mathematical formulations for finding control policies that optimize certain objectives.
Robust control involves theoretical frameworks and abstract methodologies to control systems under uncertain conditions.
Discrete control deals with theoretical aspects of system control where variables change at discrete times.
Control algorithms focus on the theoretical development of algorithms for controlling dynamic systems.
In the context of theory, control systems imply study on system properties, often looking at abstract models and frameworks.

application_domains.justification: Head direction systems pertain to practical applications within robotics, requiring implementation in real-world systems.
Legged robotics involves practical applications of robotics principles and theories in creating robots with legs for movement.
Humanoid robotics is an application domain focused on developing robots that mimic human movements and interactions.
Bipedal robotics focuses on the application of robotics to create robots with two-legged locomotion.
This involves the practical aspect of designing and building robots that walk on two legs.
Robot photography involves the use of robots in capturing images, highlighting a practical application of robotics.
Akin to 'robot photography', this is about applying robotics technology to the field of photography.
Robotic systems focus on the applications of robotics technologies in various real-world systems.
This is a broad application domain involving the use of robotics technology across different industries and tasks.
Robotics is a comprehensive application-oriented domain focusing on the development and deployment of robots in various sectors.
Governance, in the context of deep learning, refers to practical policy-making and management applications.
This involves applying research for the creation and management of policies, focused on practical governance applications.
Policy ensemble deals with practical applications of policies in various domains, often implied by governance.
Policy evaluation focuses on practical analysis and assessment of policies, implying real-world applications.
Cooperative exploration is an application area where multiple agents explore environments, often using deep learning methods.
This involves applying deep learning techniques to control systems continuously, reflecting a practical application domain.
